postgres_index.query: SELECT p.grade, COUNT(*), AVG(f.default_flag) FROM credit_risk.fact_loan f JOIN credit_risk.dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE f.is_matured_cohort AND f.date_key BETWEEN 201501 AND 201503 GROUP BY p.grade
